text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш makes her mark at the Keisei
Hai.
After the race, we hold a quick
press meeting.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Let me start by congratulating you on a
race well
run. Could you tell us how you
feel about the
race?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
This was good preparation for my next
race, and
though there are still aspects I
need to improve
upon, I have no
concerns about it.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
That's wonderful to hear. If I may ask,
what
exactly is the next race you have in
mind?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, of course. It will mark
the
beginning of my Classic Triple Crown
quest.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Oooh! I thought that might be it. You'll
be facing
some stiff competition this
year, though.
text_block_list.name: Репортёр B

text_block_list.text:
You looked great out there today, and I
wish you
the best of luck, but...
text_block_list.name: Репортёр C

text_block_list.text: I'm not the main focus... correct?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you're already aware, but there
are a lot
of big-name racers who have
their eyes on the
Triple Crown.
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text: I am aware, yes.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
What would you say your odds of
winning are
right now? The path to
victory is looking rather
difficult this
time around.
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text: There are no odds.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: What?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
I acknowledge the challenges that lie in
my path,
and I have prepared
accordingly for them.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Therefore, odds are a non-factor. I must
simply
do what must be done...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: And the results will follow. That is all.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш doesn't so much as flinch as
she
makes her declaration. No other
reporter dares
ask her a similar question.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The press conference ended fifteen
minutes
earlier than scheduled...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I should have adopted a warmer

demeanor.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: It was very cool how resolute you were.

text_block_list.text: ...I'm glad you thought so.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
This press conference made something
very clear.
Though I have garnered a
certain level of respect,
the general
consensus is that I am not good
enough
to compete for the Triple Crown.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list:
You'll just have to prove them wrong at the
Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.text:
Yes, I feel the same. It won't be long
until then.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Not only will it be on the same track as
today, it's
even the same length. I have
already committed
the run to memory.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
This will be no problem. Let's proceed as
planned.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
